answer: Underwritten stake is the Sybil brake: before bidding, an agent locks collateral and gets a single-use voucher from an already-staked peer. Ten clones need ten separate bonds and ten distinct guarantors, not one budget sliced thin. Catch one fake and slashing burns its bond plus every voucher behind it, so the attacker must also bribe people willing to risk their own funds. He can fill a wharf with servers, move them as fast as a zephyr, and mask the nebula behind fresh keys, but he cannot mint independent vouchers: his cost rises with each fake while its share of work shrinks.
